'''R2-Q2''' (also spelled '''Artoo Kyootoo''') was an [[Astromech droid/Legends|astromech droid]] of the [[R2-series astromech droid/Legends|R2-series]], known for expertise in computer uplinking, serving in the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. R2-Q2 spent several decades serving with an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] reconnaissance fleet in the [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region]]<ref name="CCG" /> aboard the [[Imperial I-class Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer]] [[Devastator/Legends|''Devastator'']].<ref name="ANH">{{Film|IV}}</ref> He had one of the most extensive maps and list of [[Star system/Legends|systems]] inside of his databanks.<ref name="Encyclopedia">''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]''</ref>

R2-Q2 was among the Imperial droids which scoured the [[Tantive IV/Legends|''Tantive IV''{{'s}}]] databanks for information after that vessel was [[Battle of Tatooine (Galactic Civil War)|captured over Tatooine]] in [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]].<ref name="Artoo's Mission">{{SWArchive|url=episode-iv/explore/visualguides/chp04.html|text=Episode IV Visual Guide &mdash; Chapter 4: Artoo's Mission}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
R2-Q2 was included in the 2011 LEGO set "[[W:c:lego:7915 Imperial V-wing Starfighter|Imperial V-Wing Starfighter]]."
